Sparkline

A small trend line beside a value, with words that say the trend and the latest value.

Status: draft

Examples

When to use it

  • Beside a number in a table cell or a stat, to show how it moved over the last few runs or days.
  • For one series of 5 to 30 points where the shape matters and the single values do not.

When not to use it

  • By itself, with no value and no words. The line cannot be read as a number.
  • When the reader needs single values, axes or more than one series. Use a table, or a chart the app builds for the purpose.
  • For progress towards a known total. Use the progress bar or the usage meter.
  • For one number with its comparison and nothing over time. Use the stat alone.
  • As decoration on a card or a heading.

Variants

with words
The default. ds-sparkline__text after the drawing says the trend, the period and the latest value in a short visible line.
words for screen readers only
The same sentence in a span with ds-visually-hidden in place of ds-sparkline__text, where the value and the period are already visible in the same row and a table has no room for the line of text.

Sizes

default
64px wide and 16px tall, with a 1.5px line. It fits a table row and a line of text without adding height.

Accessibility

  • Use a span with the class ds-sparkline holding the svg and then the words. The svg carries aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false": the drawing is not announced, and the words carry everything it shows.
  • The words are required. They say the direction, the period and the latest value with its unit, such as Rising over the last 7 runs, now 6 min 12 s. Put them in ds-sparkline__text, or in ds-visually-hidden when the same row already shows the value. Direction is a word, Rising, Falling or Steady, never the line's slope or a colour alone.
  • The app generates the svg: viewBox="0 0 64 16", one polyline with the class ds-sparkline__line, and one circle with the class ds-sparkline__last and r="2" on the last point. Spread the points evenly from x=2 to x=62 and scale the values so the lowest is at y=14 and the highest at y=2. When every value is the same, draw the line at y=8.
  • The line and the dot are drawn in the main text colour through currentColor, in both themes. Do not set a stroke or fill attribute, and do not add a fill under the line, a gradient, grid lines or an animation.
  • Do not colour the line by whether the change is good or bad. If that judgement matters, write it in the words.
  • With fewer than two values there is no line. Leave the svg out and write that in ds-sparkline__text: Not enough runs for a trend yet.
  • The component has no controls and needs no script beyond generating the points.
